method: Independent five-axis read-only review using code-review-and-quality; tests first and native evidence checked

axes.correctness: Profile revision/account generation/exact avatar identity guard stale callbacks; ordinary password uncertain result blocks replay
axes.readability: State and cancellation conditions explicit; no blocking complexity regression in reviewed core
axes.architecture: Page/ViewModel/domain/repository/platform boundaries follow ADR; domain remains platform independent
axes.security: Raw Authorization token, credentials/file tokens only in memory, no automatic password retry, owner-bound resource cleanup
axes.performance: Bounded responses/image previews/encoding attempts; no unbounded repeated network loop found

unitEvidence: Original72 real report checked by reviewer; new final-nav suite also actually rerun separately

mutationEvidence.scope: Offline actual SidePanel controller only; not native UI or business counts

limits: Reviewer did not independently run suite or mutate core sources
New native UI, material/motion, fixed preview and final runtime require their separate actual reports
15s late response evidence applies only its independent variant; no inherited2s pass
Remaining adventure/reward/notification/foldable scopes remain outside current completed business
